units.title: 电话与邮件用语 · 情景对话

items.prompt: Hello, Mr. Brown. This is Emma from Northstar Consulting. Is now a good time?
items.answer: Hello, Mr. Brown. This is Emma from Northstar Consulting. Is now a good time?

hints.zh: 您好，布朗先生。我是北极星咨询公司的艾玛。现在方便通话吗？
hints.en: The caller introduces herself and checks availability.
hints.ja: 発信者が名乗り、通話可能か確認します。

items.hint: 您好，布朗先生。我是北极星咨询公司的艾玛。现在方便通话吗？ / The caller introduces herself and checks availability. / 発信者が名乗り、通話可能か確認します。

dialogueScenes.zh: 女行政助理致电男客户，协商会议改期并发送确认邮件。
dialogueScenes.en: A female assistant calls a male client to reschedule a meeting and confirm by email.
dialogueScenes.ja: 女性アシスタントが男性顧客に電話し、会議の日程変更とメール確認を行います。

items.prompt: Hello, Emma. Yes, I have a few minutes. What can I do for you?
items.answer: Hello, Emma. Yes, I have a few minutes. What can I do for you?

hints.zh: 您好，艾玛。可以，我有几分钟。有什么事吗？
hints.en: The client confirms he can speak.
hints.ja: 顧客が通話できると答えます。

items.hint: 您好，艾玛。可以，我有几分钟。有什么事吗？ / The client confirms he can speak. / 顧客が通話できると答えます。

items.prompt: We need to move Thursday meeting. Would Friday at ten AM work for you?
items.answer: We need to move Thursday meeting. Would Friday at ten AM work for you?

hints.zh: 我们需要调整周四的会议。周五上午十点您方便吗？
hints.en: The assistant proposes a new meeting time.
hints.ja: アシスタントが新しい会議時間を提案します。

items.hint: 我们需要调整周四的会议。周五上午十点您方便吗？ / The assistant proposes a new meeting time. / アシスタントが新しい会議時間を提案します。

items.prompt: Friday at ten is fine. Will we use the same video link?
items.answer: Friday at ten is fine. Will we use the same video link?

hints.zh: 周五十点可以。还是用同一个视频链接吗？
hints.en: The client accepts and asks about the meeting link.
hints.ja: 顧客が承諾し、リンクについて尋ねます。

items.prompt: Yes, the link will stay the same. I will send an updated invitation shortly.
items.answer: Yes, the link will stay the same. I will send an updated invitation shortly.

hints.zh: 是的，链接不变。我稍后会发送更新后的邀请。
hints.en: The assistant confirms the link and promises an updated invitation.
hints.ja: アシスタントがリンクと更新通知を確認します。

items.prompt: Great. I will look for your email. Thank you for letting me know.
items.answer: Great. I will look for your email. Thank you for letting me know.
